project_type: FileForgeWorkbench -- Rust cargo workspace (egui/eframe desktop app ff-desktop + supporting crates ff-i18n, ff-config, ff-help, etc.)
build_system: cargo workspace. Agents verify COMPILE-ONLY and scoped: cargo check -p ff-desktop, cargo clippy -p ff-desktop -- -D warnings, cargo fmt -p ff-desktop -- --check. NEVER run a full `cargo test`/`cargo nextest`/`cargo gate` as an agent (terminal hangs on long runs); the OWNER runs the full gate manually.
test_framework: Rust built-in #[cfg(test)] + egui_kittest for full-shell GUI tests (harness_shell() / build_eframe in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/tests_common.rs). Scoped single-test runs: cargo test -p ff-desktop <test_name>.
build_command: C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo check -p ff-desktop *> tools\logs\check.log" then read the log (terminal-discipline.md: verify by effect, not exit code).
test_command: C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo test -p ff-desktop <test_name> *> tools\logs\test.log" then read the log. Scoped/bounded only; owner runs the full suite.
verification_instructions: TDD mandatory. For each task: (1) write the failing test first with a // Validates: localization Requirement 11.x annotation; (2) run it SCOPED and confirm it fails; (3) write the minimum implementation; (4) run it scoped and confirm it passes; (5) cargo check/clippy/fmt -p ff-desktop all clean. Pipe every command through the pwsh7 wrapper to a log file under tools/logs/ and READ the log (do not trust the Exit Code line). One command per invocation (the guard hook BLOCKS ';'-chained lines). Clean up temp files.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. No codegen/snapshots for this task. i18n .ftl and alias .toml under crates/ff-i18n/i18n/ are hand-authored DATA that ship in the repo.
environment_constraints: Windows + pwsh7 at C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe (NEVER Windows PowerShell 5.1). Python at C:\tools\python\python.exe. The shell guard hook BLOCKS any ';'-chained command and any process-kill glued onto a command -- issue ONE clean command per call. Use dedicated read/grep/glob tools for file inspection, not Get-Content/Select-String/Get-ChildItem. Verify results by effect (a produced file, a log read back), never by the reported exit code. No source .rs file may exceed 400 non-test lines (excluding #[cfg(test)]).
contribution_requirements: framework-conformance.md: build ON the single command-dispatch front door (dispatch_command_string + resolve_target), the per-environment AliasTable, and the ff_i18n::t() seam -- NO second dispatcher, NO second nav stack, NO new persistence format, NO per-Context focus mechanism. The ROOT (canonical) command stays the dispatched/persisted identity. wiring-standard.md: communicate render->shell intent by returning an action/value, do not mutate the shell from inside render; hold feature state in a grouped sub-struct, not a new flat field on WorkbenchShell. workspace-conformance.md: do NOT hand-write the menu-kind focus latch; keep the existing menu first-Tab egui_kittest test green. documentation-charset.md: ASCII-only in docs and pattern-matched source.
key_patterns: AliasTable (environment.rs) resolves surface->canonical via canonical_verb and layers locale overlays via apply_locale_overlay with a scratch-copy collision discipline (AliasOverlayError::Collision) -- model the keyed overlay and the reader on it. ff_i18n::t(key) resolves against the process-wide active catalogue (locale implicit; swapped on ui.locale reload). i18n_keys::localised_option_description(menu_name, option) is the model for localised_option_command. install_catalogue / reload wiring lives in i18n_bootstrap.rs + main.rs callback + help.rs reload -- add the alias-store reload onto the SAME seam. The single front door is dispatch_command_string (dispatch.rs); menu selection flows pending_menu_option -> activate_menu_option -> resolve_and_dispatch_command.

directory_structure: crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/ holds the WorkbenchShell (god-struct split across many files: dispatch, commands_*, render_*, environment*, construct, update, i18n_bootstrap, help, alias_overlay, tests_*). crates/ff-desktop/src/menu_workspace/ holds the shared menu renderer (render.rs, i18n_keys.rs, loader.rs, defaults.rs, mod.rs). crates/ff-i18n/ holds the Catalogue_Lookup_Seam and the i18n/<locale>/*.ftl data tree; alias .toml data goes under crates/ff-i18n/i18n/<locale>/aliases/<env>.toml. docs/specs/localization/ holds the spec; docs/quality/TCR.md the coverage record.
sequencing_caveat: No verb-level alias keys (e.g. verb-find) exist in any .ftl catalogue today because the full ff-desktop string extraction (L10N.4) is incomplete. The MECHANISM (FEAT-001/002) is fully testable now by installing a small test catalogue that defines the one or two verb keys a test needs. The af POC DATA (FEAT-003) must ALSO author the minimal verb-* keys it references (verb-find=FIND in en, verb-find=SOEK in af) in the existing .ftl tree for the surface to resolve end-to-end; without them t(key) returns the key and the surface correctly falls back to the root (Req 11.8).
